errors.fix: Declare the variable/function before use, check for a typo, or add the missing import

errors.message: A local variable was declared but never used
errors.fix: Use the variable, or remove it (Go treats unused locals as a compile error)

errors.message: A package was imported but never used
errors.fix: Use the package, or remove the import

errors.message: Type mismatch when assigning or passing a value
errors.fix: Check the expected type and convert or fix the value being passed

errors.message: Attempted to dereference a nil pointer
errors.fix: Check the pointer isn't nil before dereferencing it

errors.message: Attempted to access a slice/array index that is out of range
errors.fix: Check the length of the slice/array before indexing into it

errors.message: A multi-value expression was used where only one value is allowed
errors.fix: Assign each returned value to its own variable (e.g. v, err := f())

errors.message: A function with a return type is missing a return statement on some path
errors.fix: Make sure every code path in the function returns a value

strings: no new variables on left side of :=
errors.message: ':=' was used without introducing any new variables
errors.fix: Use '=' instead of ':=' if all variables on the left already exist

errors.message: A required package/module could not be found
errors.fix: Run 'go mod tidy' or 'go get <package>' to fetch the missing dependency
Check the file near the reported location for invalid Go syntax
Check the divisor isn't zero before performing the division

errors.message: All goroutines are asleep - deadlock detected
errors.fix: Check for a channel or mutex that's never unblocked, or a goroutine that never runs
